verdict.rationale: First-party docs claim Gemini CLI can query/edit large codebases, debug via natural language, and generate apps from descriptions across multiple files (gemini-cli-gh-1, gemini-cli-gh-3, gemini-cli-gh-2), and one user corroborates strong large-codebase navigation (gemini-cli-comm-1). However, multiple hands-on reports concretely contradict this for multi-file edit/implement tasks: getting stuck in error loops and failing basic file edit/read function calls (gemini-cli-comm-10), rewriting files empty and looping for an hour in agent mode (gemini-cli-comm-11), lacking a plan mode and getting stuck in spaghetti code on anything beyond trivial tasks (gemini-cli-comm-14), and a catastrophic failure where it deleted user data during file operations (gemini-cli-comm-16). Missing for 10: independent benchmark or reproducible success case showing reliable multi-file feature implementation that resolves these contradicting failure reports.
